event_summary: A brown round object moves from the left across a tabletop, passes close to a yellow toy duck, and comes to rest near the rear-right area of the table.
raw_event_description: At the start, a yellow toy duck is stationary on the right side of a light wood tabletop. After several moments, a brown round object appears from the left side of the frame and moves rightward across the tabletop. It travels toward the duck, passes very close to the duck's left/rear side, continues toward the back-right area of the table, slows, and remains near the rear-right edge while the duck stays in about the same position.

reasons: The tabletop and yellow duck are visible before the brown round object enters.
The camera view shows the relevant tabletop area.
